occasion: Trigram lesson, option 3 of 3: as the bars, with a neon sign of each trigram image drawn on above it (a bowl held at its level for LAKE, three waves for WATER); LAKE and its sign turn amber.

caption.text: A lake holds only so much water, and that’s what makes it a lake. Limits work; harsh limits break.

lesson.text:
A lake holds only
so much water.
